scope: Frozen calibration: table coverage, equal-label diverse coverage, weighted objective and residual basis; new batch/context validation

development_e17.scope: Development only; exact NNLS and candidate checks on previously observed E17

method.online_initialization: sparse only, then predict before current observation
method.weighted_nnls: Offline training-only control, same original 3 features; source_record_index references original raw row, no added inference samples
method.residual: raw + ridge correction [calls,new_tokens/512,raw_attention_ms/100]; weight=1/max(actual_ms,20), RMS scaling, lambda=.01, beta prior0, clamp output>=0

limits: Single machine/model/backend; changing objective and residual basis is an optional estimator, not faster inference
Two new batch caps and new context/token grid; no universal accuracy claim
Anchor ranges describe phase effects; GPU frequency/temperature, actual DRAM and pure GPU time unmeasured
Dividing coverage/control effects does not make them additive; all predictions share actual jobs
Residual model uses 3 coefficients like old model, but a different basis/prior/objective; beta is not physical attribution

Initial E18 run stopped before cap64 measurements due to prefill minimum128 exceeding batch64; all849 native rows archived separately; E19 fixes only benchmark parameters, no accuracy-based run selection

unit.scope: analytic collinear ridge, zero column, signed correction, nonnegative clamp, 64-slot eviction/drift, profile isolation, zero work, invalid-state/output atomicity; shape interpolation regression

sanitizers.scope: C residual and roofline unit suites; prebuilt engine uninstrumented
